dateline: Baltimore, Maryland, USA — ARIRANG World Tour closes two-night stand at M&T Bank Stadium (Aug 10-11); 'SWIM' ties 'Butter' for BTS's longest-ever Hot 100 run at 20 weeks; 'ARIRANG' logs 20th consecutive week on Billboard 200; next stops: Arlington AT&T Stadium (Aug 15-16), Toronto Rogers Stadium (Aug 22-23)
heroHeadline: Day 4,808: 'SWIM' Ties BTS's Longest Hot 100 Run as Baltimore Stand Wraps
heroSubtitle: August 12, 2026 is Day 4,808 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The ARIRANG World Tour closed its two-night Baltimore run at M&T Bank Stadium (Aug 10-11) with a second sold-out show, a night after a tornado warning and severe storms forced fans to shelter inside the venue; the Baltimore Sun and Fox Baltimore report the shows drew ARMY from as far as Mexico, Florida, and Ohio and gave Charm City businesses a significant tourism boost, while a Clutchpoints review likened the atmosphere to Beatlemania. On Aug 12, 'SWIM' tied 'Butter' for BTS's longest-ever Hot 100 run at 20 consecutive weeks (No. 91, chart dated Aug 15), holding No. 4 on Billboard Global (Excl. US) and No. 12 on the Billboard Global 200, while parent album 'ARIRANG' logged its own 20th consecutive week on the Billboard 200 (No. 14) — a record run for a K-pop album. The tour now heads to AT&T Stadium in Arlington (Aug 15-16) and Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23), where City Council has approved temporarily renaming a stretch of Yonge Street 'BTS Boulevard.'
